tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by five different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
The FTC is escalating its artificial intelligence safety investigation and demanding testimony from Anthropic executives, still open per Stocktwits, amid growing regulatory scrutiny of AI firms.
Anthropic is being sued over the alleged use of 274 Elvis Presley songs to train artificial intelligence models without permission, confirmed by The Express Tribune.
Synology will showcase its artificial intelligence-powered surveillance ecosystem at ISC East 2026, confirmed by The Joplin Globe, as artificial intelligence raises new data security questions.
SpaceX has agreed to a 40 billion dollar financing lease with an Apollo-managed firm for Nvidia's next-generation equipment, confirmed by The Times of India, with deliveries expected in 2027.
Anthropic's IPO filing reveals growth risks and details on CEO security services, confirmed by NBC News in a look at 6 key takeaways from the filing.
Free every hour.
